concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-in-person-reference-app-version-release-notes]] - 2026-09-16 collected Braintree website release-note inventory for sandbox and production Braintree Payment Application versions 1.2.2 through 6.0.1, routing version-qualified reader changes, upgrade prerequisites and dated certificate warnings without asserting a merchant's deployed or currently latest version
warnings: The page-level January 2026 certificate warning is later context than the Version 3.1.0 statement that older readers would continue working; preserve both as time- and section-qualified statements rather than inferring current support.
Website release notes are not GitHub or exact-commit implementation authority, and reader, application-version, platform and payment-state claims remain distinct.
